en: The image shows two illustrated cards, resembling vintage postcards. The left card features a man looking directly at the viewer, possibly from the perspective of someone wiping his face (maybe a barbershop scene). The right card shows a still life of a tea set on a patterned blue cloth, with a teapot, teacup, and pastries or biscuits, as well as what appears to be a glass of juice. Both have a painterly, mid-20th-century illustration style.
